mira_m1_01.speaker: Mira
mira_m1_01.text: Fit the battery, check the wheels, then take control from the console.

mira_m1_02.speaker: Mira
mira_m1_02.text: Kite has power. Open the mission console, select Control Kite, and head for IRIS.

hana_m1_01.speaker: Hana
hana_m1_01.text: That's Evan's service panel. The image is clear. Bring Kite home so we can check the fault.

mira_m1_03.speaker: Mira
mira_m1_03.text: Good docking. Leave Kite and send the inspection from the console's Downlink tab.

mira_m1_04.speaker: Mira
mira_m1_04.text: Diagnosis confirmed: IRIS's radio-power module failed, but its stored records survived. We need a replacement.

mira_m2_01.speaker: Mira
mira_m2_01.text: First, open Planning on the mission console. Choose a lander and order the radio-power module without exceeding the mass limit.

mira_m2_02.speaker: Mira
mira_m2_02.text: Manifest approved. The cargo is on its way. Check the delivery crate before loading Kite.

mira_m2_03.speaker: Mira
mira_m2_03.text: The module adds twelve kilograms. Take it steady on the way to IRIS, and watch your battery reserve.

mira_m2_04.speaker: Mira
mira_m2_04.text: The replacement module is seated. Run the station activation check.

hana_m2_01.speaker: Hana
hana_m2_01.text: IRIS is transmitting again. After four years, we finally have a signal. Let's bring those records home.

hana_m2_02.speaker: Hana
hana_m2_02.text: Reference sample secured. That gives us a useful comparison point for the far-rim record.

mira_m2_05.speaker: Mira
mira_m2_05.text: Kite is docked. Open Downlink at the mission console to receive IRIS's telemetry.

hana_m2_03.speaker: Hana
hana_m2_03.text: IRIS's data is here, but one record is still missing: Evan's field logger at the far rim.

mira_m3_01.speaker: Mira
mira_m3_01.text: The logger is farther out. Compare the routes, protect your return battery reserve, and watch the shaded cold zones.

hana_m3_01.speaker: Hana
hana_m3_01.text: There it is—Evan's field logger. Both labels are still attached. Bring it back safely.

mira_m3_02.speaker: Mira
mira_m3_02.text: Kite recovered. Open the Downlink tab and send the logger's archive.

hana_m3_end.speaker: Hana
hana_m3_end.text: That's Evan's last record, the one he never got to send. He left everything ready for someone to finish. Thank you.

mira_m3_end.speaker: Mira
mira_m3_end.text: Kite recovered, IRIS online, archive received. I'm closing the field report. Good work out there.

mira_alert_low_battery.speaker: Mira
mira_alert_low_battery.text: Kite's charge is close to what it needs to get home. Turn back soon.

mira_alert_cold.speaker: Mira
mira_alert_cold.text: Kite's in shade without its thermal kit. Get it back into sunlight before the electronics shut down.

mira_alert_recovery.speaker: Mira
mira_alert_recovery.text: Emergency recovery under way. Kite will be back on the pad shortly.
